description: This file is a C++ header for the StorageService API, defining the 'hostIf_StorageSrvc' class which provides interfaces for managing storage service information and related operations, including singleton instance management, message handling, and attributes related to storage devices.

classes.name: hostIf_StorageSrvc
classes.description: A class providing the TR-069 storage service information API, managing storage service instances, message processing, and attributes related to storage devices.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of 'hostIf_StorageSrvc' for the specified device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and releases the specified 'hostIf_StorageSrvc' instance.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all existing 'hostIf_StorageSrvc' instances.

methods.name: get_Device_StorageSrvc_ClientNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Gets the number of entries related to storage service clients.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for storage service attributes.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Sets storage service interface attributes, such as physical medium attributes.

methods.name: getLock
methods.description: Acquires a lock for thread-safe operations.
